rationales: Analysis is part of examining a problem, but the problem must first be defined.
Defining a problem clarifies what needs to be solved.
Un-understand is not a problem-solving step.
Planning generally follows defining and analyzing the problem.
A parallelogram typically represents input or output.
A diamond represents a decision.
A rectangle represents a processing step.
A connector is represented by a small circle or another connector symbol.
Hexadecimal has 16 symbols, not 17.
Hexadecimal uses 16 symbols: 0–9 and A–F.
Hexadecimal has 16 symbols, not 18.
Hexadecimal has 16 symbols, not 15.
Memory is primarily classified into two types: primary and secondary.
Memory is not primarily classified as only one type.
Four is not the primary number of memory types.
Memory is primarily classified into two types, not three.
A protocol governs communication but is not what the receiver accepts as the transmitted content.
The receiver must be capable of accepting the message.
An address identifies a destination but is not the content being accepted.
Information is conveyed in a message, which the receiver accepts.
The TCP/IP model is not conventionally described as having two layers.
The standard TCP/IP model has four layers, not three.
The TCP/IP model is commonly described as having four layers.
Five layers are sometimes used in related teaching models, but the standard TCP/IP model has four.
A trade secret is confidential business information, not an attack.
Sabotage deliberately damages or disrupts a computer system.
Cybercrime is a broad category of offenses, while the described serious attack is sabotage.
A patent is a legal protection for an invention, not an attack.
Software can support communication but is not the tool described here.
Hacking is unauthorized access, not a communication tool.
The Internet is an important tool for communication.
Phishing is a deceptive attack, not a communication tool.
The head element is inside the HTML document and does not begin the document structure.
The body element contains page content and appears after the head.
The opening html tag begins the HTML document structure.
The title element is placed within the head element.
The h1 tag denotes the most important heading.
The h2 tag denotes a heading of lower importance than h1.
The h5 tag denotes a relatively low-level heading.
The h3 tag is less important than h1.
A well-defined problem should not contain errors, but ambiguity is the key issue asked about.
Validation checks correctness and is not something a problem definition must exclude.
A well-defined problem is clear and does not contain ambiguities.
A picture is not a required or prohibited feature of a well-defined problem.
Understanding the problem is essential before attempting to solve it.
Defining a problem is important, but first it must be understood.
Drawing a picture may help but is not always necessary.
Guessing is not a reliable problem-solving step.
The binary system has base 2, not 16.
The decimal system has base 10.
The binary system has base 2; the option writes it as 02.
The octal system has base 8.
A petabyte is much larger than 1024 kilobytes.
A petabyte is much larger than 1024 megabytes.
A petabyte is much larger than 1024 gigabytes.
One petabyte is equal to 1024 terabytes.
A message is the data being transferred, not the complete means of transfer.
A receiver is the destination that accepts the data.
A protocol sets communication rules but is not the complete transfer system.
A communication system transfers data from one point to another.
